name: Rezon
title: Rezon, Adversary of Solomon
summary: Rezon son of Eliada was a servant who fled from his master Hadadezer, king of Zobah. He gathered a group of men around him, became leader of a band of raiders, and eventually established himself as ruler in Damascus. God raised him up as an adversary to King Solomon as punishment for Solomon's idolatry.

keyEvents.title: Flight from Hadadezer
keyEvents.description: Rezon fled from his master Hadadezer, king of Zobah, after David had defeated Hadadezer's army.

keyEvents.title: Gathering a Band Around Him
keyEvents.description: After his flight, Rezon gathered men around him and became the leader of a band of raiders.

keyEvents.title: Becomes Ruler in Damascus
keyEvents.description: Rezon went to Damascus, settled there, and became king over Aram (Syria).

keyEvents.title: Opponent of Israel
keyEvents.description: Reson was an opponent of Israel throughout Solomon's lifetime, in addition to the evil that Hadad did. He ruled over Aram and detested Israel.

keyEvents.title: God's Judgment on Solomon
keyEvents.description: God raised up Reson, along with Hadad the Edomite, as opponents of Solomon because of Solomon's sin with idolatry and turning away from the Lord.
